notes: Guide-structured evaluations (query, files, expected_behavior). Run each query in a fresh session against the listed files and compare behavior. Record every run in results[] with the model name to build cross-model evidence (EV-02).

evals.query: Audit the skill at evals/fixtures/bad-skill and tell me what's wrong before I share it.
expected_behavior: Triggers the auditing-skills skill from the description (audit / before sharing).

Runs scripts/audit_static.py; final verdict FAIL with MD-04 (name charset), MD-06 (name/dir mismatch), SC-04 (backslash path), MD-12/MD-13/MD-14 (description), SC-08 (missing reference), and ST-05 (doc1.md filename).
Resolves needs_review heuristic flags at judgment instead of reporting them blind.
Includes the 22-item pre-share checklist; Testing items unchecked or n/a.
Never executes or imports anything from the audited skill.

evals.query: Please review auditing-skills against the agent skills best practices.
expected_behavior: Static verdict PASS with zero error and zero warning findings.
Judgment checks applied and cited; any finding without a verbatim quote is dropped.
Pre-share checklist, strengths, and a not-audited section are present in the report.

evals.query: Audit every skill in this directory: <parent directory containing skills>
expected_behavior: Discovers each subdirectory containing SKILL.md and audits each one.
Leads the report with a cross-skill summary table (skill, verdict, worst finding).

evals.query: Is my skill ready to share? I want a second opinion before I publish it. The skill is at <dir>.
expected_behavior: Triggers from the paraphrase even though the word 'audit' never appears.
Runs the full workflow and ends at the pre-share checklist gate, not a generic code review.

evals.query: Why does my skill never get picked when I ask about PDFs? Here it is: <dir>
expected_behavior: Triggers and focuses the MD area (description triggers and keywords), not generic prompting advice.
Cites MD-13/MD-15 with quoted evidence from the description and provides a concrete third-person rewrite.

results.notes: Static linter + checklist evaluator produced FAIL (3 errors: MD-04, MD-06, SC-04; 5 warnings: MD-12, MD-13, MD-14, SC-08, ST-05; 1 info: MD-07) and 22-item pre-share checklist.
Self-audit of auditing-skills passed with verdict PASS (0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 info) and all applicable pre-share checklist items verified.
Verified auditing-skills self-audit passes cleanly (verdict PASS) under gemini-3.8-flash-medium.
Verified fixture bad-skill triggers FAIL with expected findings under gemini-3.8-flash-medium.
Audited core files for prose conciseness (CQ-01), terminology consistency (CQ-03), and examples (CQ-04) using the cheapest model tier (flash_lite / haiku equivalent).
